pages.title: Familiars
pages.text: A mage need not walk alone. The $(l)Ritual of Binding$() calls a familiar: a small companion that follows you, cannot be harmed, and grows stronger the longer you are together.$(br2)You may keep $(l)one$() at a time.

pages.name: Ritual of Binding
pages.text: Apprentice, 50 mana. The offering chooses the familiar: a $(item)Feather$(), $(item)Glowstone Dust$(), or an $(item)Iron Block$().

pages.title: The Owl
pages.text: $(l)Feather.$() It sees for you.$(li)Night Vision$(li)Level 2+: monsters nearby glow, further each level$(li)Level 4+: it catches you when you fall

pages.title: The Wisp
pages.text: $(l)Glowstone Dust.$() A spark of pure mana.$(li)Refills your mana: +1 every 2 seconds, rising to +3$(li)Level 4+: slowly washes away corruption

pages.title: The Golem
pages.text: $(l)Iron Block.$() Amethyst and stone, and loyal.$(li)Fights whatever hurts you, or whatever you attack. Its blows grow heavier each level$(li)Level 3+: Resistance while it's near$(li)Level 5: its blows slow enemies

pages.title: The Bond
pages.text: Bond grows by $(l)1 for every minute$() together and $(l)2 for every monster$() you defeat side by side. Levels come at 10, 30, 60 and 100.$(br2)$(li)$(l)Right-click$(): stay or follow, and see its level$(li)$(l)Sneak-right-click$(): release it$(br2)Each familiar remembers its bond, so you can switch between them freely. It follows you through death, sleep and other worlds.

pages.title: What They Do For You
pages.text: $(l)Owl:$() hoots when a monster closes in, and tells you what it is, which way, and how far.$(br2)$(l)Wisp:$() carries light with it wherever the sky is dark: caves, night, the Hollow.$(br2)$(l)Golem:$() picks up items lying near you and brings them over. It leaves alone anything you threw yourself.
